draft.subject: Re: your onboarding note — and yes, on seats
draft.body:
Hi Tunde,

Thanks for the kind words about onboarding — glad it landed well. On your question: seats can be added any time from Account Settings. Your ticket is still open with Tariq, and he'll follow up there too.

After our kickoff, the one thing that'll make Wrenfield click for your team is getting your first project in — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. From there you can invite a teammate from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Want a 15-minute call this week to set up that first project together?

Best,
Priya
